note: Native application menu bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: File/Edit/Selection/View/Go/Run/Terminal/Help
Activity bar and status bar icons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: Explorer, Search, Source Control, Run, Extensions, Accounts, Settings
Status bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for editor state: remote host, problem counts, forwarded ports, notifications, language mode, EOL, encoding, indentation, selection, screen reader mode
Accessibility container -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for screen reader announcements and status
Editor tab bar controls -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for tab actions: close, split, more; subtracts the tab labels which echo user-created file names
